install.title: Download the OCR
install.intro: The OCR reads the text of pages that have no .mokuro. It runs on this computer: pages are never uploaded anywhere. It needs these files, downloaded once:
install.introMeiki: meikiocr reads the text of pages that have no .mokuro. It runs on this computer: pages are never uploaded anywhere. It needs these files, downloaded once:
install.meikiTradeoff: It reads a page several times faster than manga-ocr, but its models were trained on video games: on manga it misses more, and its model for vertical text is in beta. manga-ocr is still the recommended engine; you can install both and switch in Settings.
install.meikiLicense: meikiocr's models (by rtr46) are published under the LGPL-3.0. They are downloaded unmodified from their author's repositories on Hugging Face, and Settings can delete them at any time.

componentHint.meikiDetector: Finds each line of text · rtr46/meiki.text.detect

install.noRoom: There may not be enough free space for the download.
install.privacy: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Runs on the CPU.
install.privacy_directml: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Uses the GPU through DirectML when it can, the CPU otherwise.
install.privacy_coreml: Every file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is kept. Uses CoreML when it can, the CPU otherwise.
install.background: You can close this window: the download goes on and Settings shows how it goes.
install.resumes: What already came down is kept: the download picks up where it stopped.
install.doneBody: Pages without text can be read now, from the reader or with “Read text” on each volume.

errors.not-remote: This volume is not on a WebDAV server.

errors.too-many: Too many boxes on one page.
errors.owocr-unavailable: owocr does not answer on this computer. Start it with read_from=websocket, write_to=websocket and output_format=json, and check the port in Settings → Manga reader.
errors.owocr-paused: owocr is paused. Unpause it (p in its terminal, or its tray icon) and try again.
errors.owocr-timeout: owocr took the page but sent nothing back in time. Its log says why: when its engine fails it sends nothing.
errors.owocr-no-coordinates: owocr answered with plain text, without boxes. Start it with output_format=json and an engine that gives coordinates (with Manga OCR, the segmented one: mangaocrs).
errors.owocr-bad-reply: Something else answers on that port: it is not owocr.
errors.bad-box: That box is too small to read.
errors.bad-port: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.

volume.processHint: Read the text of every page without it, in the background, with the OCR chosen in Settings. A notification says when it is done.
volume.installHint: Download the built-in OCR to read the text of this volume.

export.title: Export as .mokuro
export.body: Writes the volume's text (mokuro's, the OCR's and your corrections) as a .mokuro file next to the volume, so Mokuro Reader and other readers can use it.
export.bodyRemote: Uploads the volume's text (mokuro's, the OCR's and your corrections) as a .mokuro file next to the volume on the server, so Mokuro Reader and other clients of that server can use it.
export.permission: This writes to the server: your account there needs permission to write. Nothing else on the server is changed.
export.exists: There is already a .mokuro next to this volume. Replace it with this one?
export.existsRemote: The server already has a .mokuro for this volume. Replace it with this one? It is only replaced if nobody changed it since.

setup.title: Read online sources with extensions
setup.body: Extensions are the sources of Tachiyomi and Mihon, from the Keiyoushi store. They run in Suwayomi-Server, a small server on this computer that the app can install and start for you, or in your own.
setup.thirdParty: Suwayomi and the extensions are made by other people. Nothing is downloaded or started until you choose.

mode.managedHint: The app downloads Suwayomi-Server and Java, runs it only while you use extensions and stops it when you close the app.
mode.customHint: A Suwayomi-Server you already run, on this computer or your network.

install.title: Install Suwayomi-Server
install.intro: To use extensions the app will download and install Suwayomi-Server, an open-source server written in Java, and the Java 21 runtime it needs. It runs headless on this computer: no window, no browser, only reachable from this computer.

componentHint.server: The server, as released by its authors ({{size}})
componentHint.java: The Java runtime it runs on (about {{size}} unpacked)

install.noRoom: There may not be enough free space on this disk.
install.local: It listens only on 127.0.0.1, with a random port and a password only the app knows. It starts when you use extensions and stops after a while unused and when you close the app.
install.thirdParty: Extensions are third-party code that runs inside that server and talks to the sites it reads. Install only those you trust.
install.license: Suwayomi-Server is free software by the Suwayomi Project (MPL-2.0), downloaded unmodified and checked against a fixed SHA-256. Java is Eclipse Temurin (GPLv2 with Classpath Exception).
install.background: You can close this window: the download carries on.
install.doneBody: It starts when you open the Extensions tab.
